findings.claim: The lead coach's weekly read states the starting weight, a session count, a food-log gap and a journal gap, all four wrong against the data served on the same page
findings.served: “54 logged training sessions in thirty days, consistent daily movement, and a weight loss rate holding at 3.3 pounds per week from his starting weight of 302.2 pounds on day 42.” (full served text continues: “his food logs stopped four days ago, and his journal entries have been silent for forty days”)
findings.source: /api/edition blocks.lead_read (as_of 2026-10-17, /api/weekly_priority). Same response: blocks.today start_weight_lbs 327.3, weight_lbs 302.2 (302.2 is the CURRENT weight); /api/training_overview training.workouts_30d 39 (Hevy /api/workouts count 22); blocks.week.measures.food values logged 10-12..10-17 (6 of 7 days, /api/nutrition_overview nutrition_trend last date 2026-10-17 = the day before as_of); blocks.his_words as_of 2026-09-23 = 25 days, not forty; 25.1 lb / 6 weeks = 4.2 lb/wk, the scorecard's own 7-day drop is 3.4
findings.fix: Run weekly_priority through the grounded-generation number gate with the canonical facts block (ADR-104 arm 2) and fail-closed on a number that labels a served fact wrongly (302.2 is in the input, so the allow-list passes it — add a labelled-fact check: 'starting weight' must equal start_weight_lbs); until then do not quote the lead on the week page, or quote only the sentence with no numbers.
